mapper.select: SELECT FROM fin.entry WHERE entry_ym=#{month} AND deleted_yn='N' ORDER BY entry_id
SELECT FROM fin.entry WHERE entry_id=#{id} AND deleted_yn='N'
SELECT FROM fin.entry WHERE entry_id=#{id} AND deleted_yn='N' FOR UPDATE
SELECT copy_entry_id FROM fin.entry WHERE entry_ym=#{month} AND copy_entry_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT to_char(d,'YYYY-MM') AS month,COALESCE(c.cls_stts_cd,'OPEN') AS status, (SELECT count(*) FROM fin.entry e WHERE e.entry_ym=to_char(d,'YYYY-MM') AND e.deleted_yn='N') AS saved_count FROM generate_series(to_date(#{year} || '-01-01','YYYY-MM-DD'),to_date(#{year} || '-12-01','YYYY-MM-DD'),interval '1 month') d LEFT JOIN fin.mth_cls c ON c.cls_ym=to_char(d,'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY d
SELECT cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_ym=#{month}
mapper.update: UPDATE fin.entry SET entry_ym=#{input.entry_ym},fin_se_cd=#{input.fin_se_cd},item_nm=#{input.item_nm}, entry_amt=#{input.entry_amt},vat_amt=#{input.vat_amt},inout_dt=#{input.inout_dt},rpt_yn=#{input.rpt_yn}, inout_cmpl_yn=#{input.inout_cmpl_yn},rmrk_desc=#{input.remark},copy_entry_id=#{input.copy_entry_id}, auto_fill_yn=#{input.auto_fill_yn},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE entry_id=#{id} AND deleted_yn='N'
UPDATE fin.entry SET deleted_yn='Y',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE entry_id=#{id} AND deleted_yn='N'
